provenance.notes: Algorithm-prefixed digests are the digest; an image index digest and Git commit / blob ids name repository or registry objects (context, not file Indicators); the 32-hex label inside a workers.dev host is part of the host; '/TCP' after ip:port is the transport, the address is the Indicator; a bibliography appendix nested under an IOC heading asserts nothing; the post's featured image URL is page metadata.
